description.value: Beere Brewing is a father-and-son craft brewery and tasting room on Esplanade East in North Vancouver, pouring a rotating lineup of house-brewed ales, IPAs, lagers, and sours with playful names. The taproom features outdoor seating and a retail shop selling individual cans to go. The brewery leans into local sourcing, using BC-grown ingredients including Pemberton hops and Armstrong barley in some of its beers.
